texts.li: [deed:good] {X_nameDef}, a scribe of {FACTION}, has set up at the colony's table with quills and good paper. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and {X_nameDef} wanted to see it.\n\nFor {COUNT} silver, {X_nameDef} will write a letter for anyone who wants to send word somewhere.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef}, a cook of {FACTION}, heard on the road that this colony is the place that {DEED}, and came to cook for it. Give {X_nameDef} the run of the kitchen and the stores for a day, and the colony will remember the meal.\n\nOr, for {COUNT} silver, {X_nameDef} will spend the day teaching the colony's own cook.

[deed:good] Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, so when {X_nameDef}, a traveling healer of theirs, saw {A_nameDef}'s {TALE} from the gate, the healer stopped. For {COUNT} silver, or a few doses of medicine for the road, {X_nameDef} will see to it today.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef}, a wandering player of {FACTION}, came this way on purpose: among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}. Tonight {X_nameDef} has noticed {A_nameDef}, worn thin and short with everyone, and offers to play for {A_objective} alone after supper.

[deed:bad] {X_nameDef}, a peacemaker of {FACTION}, came in spite of what {FACTION} say of the colony: that it {WRONG}. Mending quarrels is {X_nameDef}'s trade, and within the hour the peacemaker had noticed {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} keeping well apart, and offered to hear them both out.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef} and a few others of {FACTION} have come with an unusual request. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and now word has reached {PLACE} that it decides things in council. They would like to stay a day and see how it's done.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} teaches children their letters, a day here and a week there, and chose this colony for the name it has among {FACTION}: the place that {DEED}. For {COUNT} silver, {X_nameDef} will give the colony's children a day of lessons.

[town:struggling] Three of {FACTION}'s people stopped at the gate with axes on their shoulders and nothing in their packs. Their home is {FORTUNE} this year, and they are looking for work wherever there is any: a day's work for a day's food, or a winter's wood for {COUNT} silver.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef} and two others of {FACTION} have come to the gate looking for work. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and they would rather work for it than for anyone. They'll fell and split wood for a meal each, or a winter's worth for {COUNT} silver.

[deed:good,!station] {X_nameDef}, a traveling barber of {FACTION}, has set a stool down by the gate. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and the barber has come to give any of its people a new cut, whatever their way or their taste. Those who'd like one: {TALE}.

[town:struggling,!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a traveling doctor of {FACTION}, is going from settlement to settlement with a case of vaccines. {X_nameDef}'s home is {FORTUNE} this year, and every sale helps. For {COUNT} silver, every colonist gets a shot, and for a month they'll fight off sickness noticeably better.
[deed:good,tale] {X_nameDef}, a storyteller of {FACTION}, has a tale about this colony, the place that {DEED}, and has come to try it on the people it is about: "{TALE}"

[deed:good,notale] {X_nameDef}, a storyteller of {FACTION}, has come to spend an evening at the colony. Among {FACTION} it is known as the place that {DEED}, and {X_nameDef} would like to hear the colony's side of it over supper.

[tie:favour:theirs,notale] {X_nameDef}, a storyteller of {FACTION}, has come to spend an evening at the colony, and asks after {FAVOURFOR}, to whom {X_possessive} people still owe a favour. {X_nameDef} will pay for supper and a bed in stories.

[deed:good] Pilgrims of {FACTION} have walked up to the gate, footsore and thin. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and they came this way hoping for a meal before they go on.
[deed:bad] Pilgrims of {FACTION} have stopped outside the colony. They know what their people say of it, that it {WRONG}, and they are hungry enough to ask for a meal anyway.

[town:struggling] Pilgrims of {FACTION} have come to the gate with nothing left in their bags. Their home is {FORTUNE} this year, and they left it with less than they would have liked. They ask for one meal before they go on.

[deed:good] {X_nameDef}, a scholar of {FACTION}, asks for a bed for the night. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and {X_nameDef} would like to write it down properly. On hearing that the colony is working on {TALE}, {X_nameDef} offers what {X_pronoun} knows.
[deed:good] Travelers from {FACTION} are on their way to stand at the grave of {DEAD}. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and they would rather mourn among friends.

[deed:good] A lone traveler knocked at the gate at dusk, white with frost: {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who won't make it home before dark. It's {TALE} outside, and {X_nameDef} came to this gate because the colony is known as the place that {DEED}.\n\n{X_nameDef} asks for a place near the fire for the night.

[deed:bad] {X_nameDef}, a tinker of {FACTION}, has pulled a handcart up to the gate and names a price: {COUNT} silver to go through everything the colony wears or fights with. {FACTION} have not forgotten that the colony {WRONG}, and {X_nameDef} doesn't pretend otherwise.

[deed:good] A runner of {FACTION} came in at dawn. Fever is going through their settlement, and among {FACTION} the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, so they came here first. They ask for {TALE}, and can pay {COUNT} silver if they must.

[town:struggling] A runner of {FACTION} came in at dawn with bad news. Their home was already {FORTUNE} before the fever came, and now their healers have nothing left. They ask for {TALE}, and can pay {COUNT} silver if they must.

[deed:good] Traders of {FACTION} have broken down on the road below with a full load. Among {FACTION}, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and they came up to the gate hoping that still holds.\n\n{A_nameDef} is the best hand in the colony for the repair. Otherwise they'll pay {COUNT} silver for {TALE} and manage it themselves.

[deed:bad] Traders of {FACTION} have broken down on the road below. They know what their people say of the colony, that it {WRONG}, and they came up to the gate anyway, because there is nowhere else.\n\n{A_nameDef} is the best hand in the colony for the repair. Otherwise they'll pay {COUNT} silver for {TALE} and manage it themselves.

[deed:good] {FACTION} would rather buy from people they trust, their rider says, and among them the colony is known as the place that {DEED}. They want {TALE}, for {COUNT} silver, and will send for it in five days, the whole order or none of it.

[deed:bad] {FACTION} have not forgotten that the colony {WRONG}, and their rider says so plainly. But they are short, and they want {TALE} for {COUNT} silver. They'll send for it in five days, all of it or none.

[town:thriving|town:flourishing] {FACTION} are doing well, {FORTUNE} by their rider's account, and they are buying. They want {TALE} from the colony's stores for {COUNT} silver, and will send for it in five days, all of it or none.

[deed:good] {FACTION}'s caravan has stopped in the road on its way to the market at {PLACE}. Among them, the colony is known as the place that {DEED}, and the caravan master offers room on the wagons: send {TALE} along, and they'll bring back {THING}, which the colony is short of.

[deed:good] {FACTION}'s crier stopped at the colony on the way round: the harvest fair at {PLACE} opens this week, and the place that {DEED} is wanted there. A cart of {TALE} would sell well, and {A_nameDef} thinks the best of it could take a prize.

[deed:bad] {X_nameDef}, reeve to a lord of {FACTION}, read the claim out at the gate: {COUNT} silver, or {TALE} in kind, to be carried to {PLACE}. {FACTION} have not forgotten that the colony {WRONG}, and the reeve reads the sum with some satisfaction.\n\n{A_nameDef} would like to see the deed to these lands.
